strapiBlog.short_description: Address Residences Zabeel, an off-plan development by Emaar Properties, epitomizes luxury living in the heart of Dubai.

data.text:
Address Residences Zabeel, an off-plan development by Emaar Properties, epitomizes luxury living in the heart of Dubai. Situated in the prestigious Zabeel district, this project offers a selection of meticulously designed apartments and penthouses that redefine urban sophistication. With its strategic location and unparalleled amenities, Address Residences Zabeel presents an exceptional opportunity for discerning investors and homeowners seeking an elevated lifestyle.

Overview of Address Residences Zabeel

Prime Location

Nestled in the vibrant Zabeel area, Address Residences Zabeel boasts proximity to key landmarks such as the Dubai Frame, Zabeel Park, and the Dubai International Financial Centre. Residents will enjoy seamless connectivity to major highways, ensuring effortless access to the city's business and leisure hubs.

Diverse Property Options

The development comprises four iconic towers, offering a range of residences to suit various preferences:

  • 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments
  • 4-bedroom penthouses

Each unit is thoughtfully designed to maximize space, natural light, and panoramic views of the city skyline.

Competitive Pricing and Flexible Payment Plan

  • Starting Price: AED 1.8 million
  • Payment Plan:
    20% down payment
    70% during construction
    10% upon handover
  • Handover Date: September 2029
     

This investor-friendly payment structure facilitates a manageable investment journey, aligning with various financial plans.

Exceptional Amenities

Address Residences Zabeel offers an array of world-class amenities designed to enhance the living experience. These include a state-of-the-art fitness center, swimming pools with panoramic views, dedicated children's play areas, landscaped gardens and walking paths, 24/7 concierge and security services, and a selection of retail outlets and dining options within the complex. These features of Address Residences Zabeel underscore its commitment to luxury and comfort.

Compelling Reasons to Invest in Address Residences Zabeel

Esteemed Developer

Emaar Properties, renowned for iconic projects such as the Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall, brings its expertise and commitment to excellence to Address Residences Zabeel. Investors can have confidence in the quality and timely delivery associated with Emaar's developments.

Strategic Location

The Zabeel district is a sought-after area, offering a blend of tranquility and urban convenience. Its central location ensures residents are minutes away from major business districts, shopping centers, and entertainment venues.

Superior Connectivity

Proximity to major highways and public transportation networks guarantees seamless travel throughout Dubai. This connectivity enhances the appeal for both residents and potential tenants.

Attractive Payment Terms

The flexible 90/10 payment plan, with a manageable down payment and staggered installments, makes investing in Address Residences Zabeel accessible to a broad spectrum of buyers.

High Rental Yield Potential

Given the prime location and premium amenities, properties in Address Residences Zabeel are anticipated to yield competitive rental returns, making it a lucrative investment opportunity. The superior lifestyle at Address Residences Zabeel elevates its long-term value for investors and residents alike.

In conclusion, Address Residences Zabeel represents a harmonious blend of luxury, convenience, and investment potential. Prospective buyers are encouraged to consult with the experts at Provident Estate to explore opportunities within this prestigious development.

About Emaar Properties

Emaar Properties is a globally recognized real estate developer based in Dubai, known for shaping the city's skyline with landmark projects. With a portfolio that spans residential, commercial, and hospitality sectors, Emaar is synonymous with quality, innovation, and timely delivery. The company's commitment to excellence has earned it a reputation as one of the most admired real estate developers worldwide.
